name: ai-translate-hover
description: Translate a selected word after hovering it for one second.

aiTranslateHover.apiKey.description: Optional API key. Stored in VS Code settings; use a secure settings target when appropriate.

aiTranslateHover.targetLanguage.description: Target language for non-Chinese text. Chinese text is translated to English.

enumDescriptions: Translate when hovering over a selected word.
Translate the selected word with the keyboard shortcut only.
Enable both hover and keyboard shortcut triggers.
aiTranslateHover.triggerMode.description: How translation is triggered. Assign a shortcut for AI Translate: Translate Selection in Keyboard Shortcuts to use keyboard triggering.

aiTranslateHover.builtinApiEnabled.description: Use the built-in Youdao mobile translation service before the configured OpenAI-compatible API.

aiTranslateHover.trustPronunciationDomai.description: Add dict.youdao.com to VS Code trusted domains when the extension activates, so pronunciation links do not require confirmation.

aiTranslateHover.hoverDelayMs.description: Additional hover duration before a translation request starts, in milliseconds.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyEnabled.description: Enable the external vocabulary API adapter for English dictionary queries.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyAutoSave.description: Automatically save every successful English dictionary query. Disable to show a Save button in the hover popup.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyUrl.description: Full URL of the external vocabulary API.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyMethod.description: HTTP method used by the external vocabulary API.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyHeaders.description: JSON object of additional request headers for the external vocabulary API.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyAuthType.description: Authentication method for the external vocabulary API.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyAuthToken.description: Bearer token, or username:password for Basic authentication.

aiTranslateHover.vocabularyBodyTemplate.description: POST body or GET parameter JSON template. Supports {{word}}, {{definition}}, {{phoneticUS}}, and {{phoneticUK}}.
